name: midnight-palette
description: Dibby helps choose painting and drawing sessions from Midnight Palette and coaches practical techniques.

interface.longDescription: Choose projects that fit your time, supplies and experience, follow illustrated lessons, and get practical painting and drawing guidance. Connects to the public lesson catalog; does not access private boards or generate paid images.
defaultPrompt: Help me choose something to paint tonight.
My acrylic dries before I can blend it. Help me fix it.
Help me practice drawing with the supplies I have.
